about_the_game:
Congratulations!

During the latest parish council meeting we have unanimously agreed that you are to be editor-in-chief of our community newsletter "Jobsworth Weekly". Adhere to the publishing guidelines and make decisions with great consideration for the future of the village.

A true slice of Middle England

Explore a quaint seaside English village, get to know the local faces and control the spread of information from the comfort of your favourite legally distinct operating system, Half Frame OS.

Inspired by real life, "Jobsworth Weekly" lets you release 12 editions of the newsletter stretching across many local festivals and traditions. You will have to decide what is deserving of attention and live with the consequences.

content_descriptors.notes: The game makes audio and text based references to potentially upsetting themes such as death, consumption of alcohol/drugs and British politics.
